name: smwgraphics-chrono-trigger-zenan-bridge
title: Chrono Trigger - Zenan Bridge
description:
An ocean-view Background that appears in various places (but most notably, the Zenan Bridge) from Chrono Trigger. There's three variations of this Background, being them:

Zenan Bridge
North Cape/West Cape (West Cape's the same of the North Cape, but with the Zenan Bridge colors)
Dactyl Nest (I've changed a little and added some more clouds to fill the BG empty spaces).

Both North Cape and Dactyl Nest doesn't have Horizontal Scroll.

There's also an alternative palette of the Sea from Zenan Bridge seen on the Tidal Wave cutscene's Palette Row.

Originally Requested by isaix.
